people.name: Alexandros Zaimis
people.nameZh: 亞歷山德羅斯·扎伊米斯

body.zh-Hant: 札伊米斯是希臘政治家，生於雅典。來源稱他進入政壇後以持平、溫和與愛國著稱；1897年10月他首度被召出任首相，任務是收拾對土耳其那場不幸的戰爭。德國國家圖書館權威檔另將他列為政府首腦、政治家與銀行家。
body.en: Zaimis was a Greek statesman born in Athens. Once in politics he became known for balance, moderation and patriotism, and in October 1897 he was first called to the premiership to wind up the unfortunate war with Turkey. The German National Library authority file also lists him as head of government, politician and banker.

citations.quote: Uomo di stato greco, nato ad Atene
il suo equilibrio, la sua moderazione, il suo patriottismo
chiamato la prima volta alla presidenza del consiglio nell'ottobre 1897
per liquidare la sfortunata guerra con la Turchia
Regierungschef
Politiker
Bankier

body.zh-Hant: 1906年9月，札伊米斯被任命為克里特高級專員。他前往動盪的島上，以機智和成效恢復平靜與秩序。1909年10月，克里特議會趁他不在時宣布該島併入希臘，他的專員任期實際上就此結束。
body.en: In September 1906 Zaimis was appointed High Commissioner of Crete. He went to the troubled island and worked with tact and success to restore calm and order. In October 1909 the Cretan Assembly, in his absence, proclaimed the island's annexation to Greece, and his commissionership practically ended.

citations.quote: Nel settembre 1906 fu nominato alto commissario di Creta
si adoperò con tatto e successo a ristabilire la calma e l'ordine
praticamente finì nell'ottobre 1909
l'Assemblea cretese, nella sua assenza, proclamò l'annessione
alla Grecia

heading.zh-Hant: 世界大戰期間三度組閣
heading.en: Three premierships in the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰期間他三度出任首相：1915年10月、1916年6至9月、1917年3至6月。來源稱他基本上主張希臘站到協約國一方，但希望各政黨先達成協議；他設法調解國王君士坦丁與韋尼澤洛斯的分歧，未能成功，便提出辭呈。
body.en: During the world war he was prime minister three times: October 1915, June-September 1916 and March-June 1917. The source says he was basically for Greek intervention beside the Entente but wanted it reached by agreement among the parties; he tried to reconcile King Constantine and Venizelos, failed, and resigned.

citations.quote: a tre riprese presidente del consiglio
(ottobre 1915; giugno-settembre 1916; marzo-giu5no 1917)
citations.evidenceNote: 來源原文「giu5no」為排印錯字，依上下文讀作 giugno（6月）

citations.quote: Egli in fondo era per l'intervento della Grecia a fianco dell'Intesa
si adoperò a comporre il dissidio fra re Costantino e Venizelos
Non essendoci riuscito, diede le dimissioni

body.zh-Hant: 札伊米斯曾是希臘出席凡爾賽和談的代表之一，後來出任國家銀行總裁。1926年12月4日他再度出任首相，組成民族團結政府，維持到1928年6月，韋尼澤洛斯在那時重掌政權。
body.en: Zaimis was among Greece's delegates to the Versailles peace negotiations and later governor of the National Bank. On 4 December 1926 he returned as prime minister, forming a government of national union that lasted until June 1928, when Venizelos resumed power.

citations.quote: Fu tra i delegati della Grecia nei negoziati di pace di Versailles
poi governatore della Banca nazionale
il 4 dicembre 1926
formando un governo di unione nazionale
si mantenne fino al giugno 1928
quando Venizelos riprese il potere

heading.en: President of the Republic and resignation

body.zh-Hant: 1929年12月14日札伊米斯當選共和國總統，1934年10月26日獲連任。來源稱他在任內沒有阻擋君主制復辟運動；1935年10月11日國民議會批准恢復君主制後，他隨即辭職。他於1936年9月15日在維也納去世。
body.en: On 14 December 1929 Zaimis was elected President of the Republic and was re-confirmed on 26 October 1934. The source says he put no obstacle in the way of the monarchist restoration movement; he resigned right after the decision to restore the monarchy of 11 October 1935. He died in Vienna on 15 September 1936.

citations.quote: Il 14 dicembre 1929 fu eletto presidente della repubblica
riconfermato il 26 ottobre 1934
restaurazione monarchica
Si dimise dall'alta carica all'indomani della deliberazione
(11 ottobre 1935)
morto a Vienna il 15 settembre 1936
Nel settembre 1906 fu nominato alto commissario di Creta
praticamente finì nell'ottobre 1909

people.name: Ricardo Adolfo de la Guardia
people.nameZh: 里卡多·阿道弗·德拉瓜迪亞

heading.en: Origins, cabinet post and seizure of power

body.zh-Hant: 德拉瓜迪亞生於1899年6月14日，1941年至1945年任巴拿馬總統。他原是阿爾努爾福·阿里亞斯總統任內的政府與司法部長，後來組織運動推翻這位獨裁者，並在國民警衛隊、寡頭集團與多數巴拿馬民眾支持下就任總統。
body.en: De la Guardia was born on 14 June 1899 and was president of Panama from 1941 to 1945. Minister of government and justice under President Arnulfo Arias Madrid, he organised a movement to depose the dictator and assumed the presidency with the support of the National Guard, the oligarchy and much of the Panamanian populace.

citations.quote: b. 14 June 1899
president of Panama (1941–1945)

heading.zh-Hant: 珍珠港事件與美軍基地

body.zh-Hant: 珍珠港遇襲引發巴拿馬運河可能成為攻擊目標的憂慮；德拉瓜迪亞支持在巴拿馬興建美軍基地的爭議計畫。
body.en: The attack on Pearl Harbor brought fear that the Panama Canal would become a target, and De la Guardia endorsed controversial plans for the construction of US bases in Panama.

citations.quote: The attack on Pearl Harbor brought fear
the Panama Canal would become a target
endorsed controversial plans for the construction of U.S. bases in Panama

body.zh-Hant: 1944年國民議會反抗德拉瓜迪亞的權威，堅持要他指定合憲的繼任人；他的回應是解散議會並廢止1941年憲法。1945年他召集選舉，產生新議會，並由恩里克·A·希門尼斯出任臨時總統。
body.en: In 1944 the National Assembly rebelled against Guardia's authority, insisting that he name a constitutional successor; he responded by dissolving the assembly and abrogating the 1941 constitution. He called elections in 1945 that established a new assembly and installed Enrique A. Jiménez as provisional president.

he dissolved the assembly and abrogated the 1941 constitution

that established a new assembly

body.zh-Hant: 1949年阿里亞斯重新掌權，德拉瓜迪亞被迫逃往運河區，在那裡待到1951年。
body.en: Arias returned to power in 1949, forcing De la Guardia to flee to the Canal Zone, where he remained until 1951.

body.zh-Hant: 佩尼亞蘭達生於拉巴斯省的拉雷卡哈，一生大半在軍中度過，從士官生升到上將；查科戰爭期間他是軍隊最高指揮官。德國國家圖書館權威檔把他列為國家元首與政治家；出生日期各來源不一，正文不採。
body.en: Peñaranda was born in Larecaja, La Paz Province, spent most of his life in the military and rose from cadet to full general; during the Chaco War he was supreme commander of the military forces. body.en: In 1937 younger and more radical officers seized power, and the next year Peñaranda took a leave of absence from the military. After their fall following the death of President Germán Busch in 1939 he emerged rapidly as the main Bolivian leader, first as minister of defense.

body.zh-Hant: 佩尼亞蘭達於1940年4月至1943年12月任玻利維亞總統，德國國家圖書館權威檔記為1940至1943年。百科條目稱他強烈親美的外交政策為玻利維亞帶來美國大量的關注與援助；任內推動民主改革、強化立法機關，並使行政現代化。
body.en: Peñaranda was president of Bolivia from April 1940 to December 1943; the German National Library authority file records 1940-1943. The encyclopedia says his strong pro-US foreign policy brought Bolivia much US attention and aid, and that during his presidency democratic reforms were undertaken, the legislative branch strengthened and the administration modernised.
